entry.title: MERTHUR - Lost Love Is Sweeter When It's Finally Found
entry.summary:
Author: writingcreature

Rating: MatureLanguage: EnglishWords: 8,138Chapters: 2/?Kudos: 10

Summary: Merlin has lived for centuries, but in this quiet Cornish fishing village he is simply “Merle,” keeper of a cramped, salt‑stained bookshop called The Last Page. His magic misbehaves now, flaring with his moods: fireworks when joy slips through, crockery shattering when anger rises, or he hasn't slept well, plants withering as he passes when sorrow drags at him. He keeps to himself, speaking only with Rosalie, the sharp‑tongued witch whose steady, sea‑rooted magic has anchored the village longer than he has. One grey morning, the Penrose ties up at the harbor. Its owner, Arthur Penrose, is not just reminiscent of the once‑and‑future king... he is identical. No memories of any past life; instead, driven by a modern man’s hunger for wrecks, charts, and legends. Will they reclaim the love they lost, or will Arthur sail away and leave Merlin heartbroken all over again?
